external_matches.query_passage: A scooter-sharing system or kicksharing system is a shared transport service in which e-scooters are made available to use for short-term rentals. E-scooters are typically "dockless," meaning that they do not have a fixed home location and are dropped off and picked up from certain locations in the service area. To rent a dockless e-scooter, users download a smartphone application. The application shows users a map of nearby e-scooters and enables them to unlock them. Scooters are equipped with built-in GPS chips and cellular connectivity which allows them to report their location in real time during a trip.
